description: Header file containing common utility functions, classes, macros, and constants for the ANGLE project, including memory management helpers, array utilities, string formatting, and graphics format definitions.

classes.name: NonCopyable
classes.description: A helper class to disallow copy and assignment operators, used as a base class for non-copyable objects.

methods.name: ArraySize
methods.description: Returns the size of a static array.

methods.name: WrappedArray
methods.description: A final class template that wraps a static array, providing size and access methods.

methods.name: SafeRelease
methods.description: Releases COM-like resources safely, either for a block or a single resource.

methods.name: SafeDelete
methods.description: Deletes a pointer and sets it to nullptr.

methods.name: SafeDeleteContainer
methods.description: Deletes all elements in a container and clears it.

methods.name: SafeDeleteArray
methods.description: Deletes a dynamically allocated array and sets pointer to nullptr.

methods.name: StructLessThan
methods.description: Compares two structs for less-than based on memory comparison.

methods.name: StructEquals
methods.description: Checks if two structs are equal based on memory comparison.

methods.name: IsMaskFlagSet
methods.description: Checks if specific bits are set in a mask.

methods.name: MakeStaticString
methods.description: Returns a static C-string for a given std::string, storing it in a static set.

methods.name: ArrayString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of an array index (function declaration only).

methods.name: ArrayIndexString
methods.description: Returns a string with reversed array indices (function declaration only).

methods.name: Str
methods.description: Converts an integer to a string.

methods.name: FormatStringIntoVector
methods.description: Formats a string into a vector buffer using printf-style formatting.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts a value to its string representation.
